items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley and WR DeVonta Smith officially off injury report and good to go for MNF vs Bears; Hollywood Brown OUT.
items.why: Off report; full clearance after prior stinger/hamstring notes.
items.implication: Full PHI weapons available; high confidence starts.

items.text: Bears officially ruled out Caleb Williams (hamstring) for MNF vs Eagles; Tyson Bagent listed QUESTIONABLE after clearing steps to practice (concussion protocol progress).
items.why: Hamstring; official rule-out; Bagent full participant but Q.
items.implication: Bagent likely start if cleared; impacts CHI pass catchers vs PHI.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL for Sunday Night vs Broncos (hip/groin); ETR and reports indicate unlikely to play, second straight miss possible with Week 4 return expected absent setback.
items.why: DNP all week; McVay: doubtful means more unlikely than likely; groin/hip soreness.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in Rams offense; elevate Adams/others.
items.opportunity: Adams high route/target rate without Nacua historically.

items.text: Nico Collins ruled OUT (hamstring) for Texans vs Colts; confirmed across reports.
items.implication: Boosts Schultz target share significantly as seen last week (28-30% routes).
items.opportunity: Schultz 28% target share last week without Collins; Colts allow high TE yards.

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT (left elbow dislocation) vs Seahawks; Mariota to start. Not expected IR; surgery not on table; possible Week 5-6 return.
items.why: Dislocated non-throwing elbow Week 2; GM positive longer-term but ruled out this week.
items.implication: Mariota start lowers WAS ceiling; McLaurin still viable but tough SEA matchup.
items.opportunity: McLaurin historically solid with Mariota (25% targets).

items.text: Rico Dowdle OUT (toe); Jaylen Warren to lead Steelers RB group per coach comments; projecting Warren in despite Q (shoulder).
items.why: Toe injury; coach: Warren leads, breathers for freshness; Homer/Heidenreich backups.
items.implication: Warren volume spike + checkdowns if vertical pass fails for Rodgers.
items.opportunity: Lead RB role; high touch potential.

items.text: Projecting Qs Jaylen Warren, Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) in for Sunday. Jahmyr Gibbs sets new ETR ceiling projection record at 44.0 (top 25th %ile avg).
items.why: Current projections assume in despite Q tags; Gibbs massive home workload vs Jets.
items.implication: Start with confidence if no late news; Gibbs elite ceiling play.
items.opportunity: Gibbs ridiculous early workload continues; Qs maintain roles.

items.text: JK Dobbins and RJ Harvey IN; Malik Nabers IN; Travis Etienne IN. Jonah Coleman OUT/IR (high ankle, short-term). Alec Pierce OUT/IR.
items.why: ETR comprehensive list; Schefter Coleman short-term IR late Oct return; Pierce IR confirmed.
items.implication: Broncos RB committee healthy-ish (Coleman out); Nabers full go; Colts WR depth hit (Downs beneficiary noted elsewhere).

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren leads Steelers RBs; vertical pass not working for Rodgers so expect heavy checkdowns to Warren. Projecting Warren (Q shoulder) in.
items.why: Coach confirmation of lead role; practice squad backups; checkdown volume likely.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with path to high floor/ceiling via receptions.
items.opportunity: Lead carries + dump-offs; fresh via managed snaps.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected/placed on IR (limited games career); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead RB (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup.
items.why: Only 5 career games; IR move locks Hubbard lead.
items.implication: Hubbard clear every-down lead back for CAR.

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Nacua as Ram, targeted on 42%; prior misses produced big games (e.g. 8-195-2).
items.why: Historical route/target rate data when Nacua absent.
items.implication: Adams WR1 upside elevated with Nacua doubtful.
items.opportunity: 42% target rate on routes without Nacua.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush prop 88.5, DAL 30th rush D (173.5 ypg). Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches/15% targets both weeks, RB7 util, PIT soft vs RBs.
items.opportunity: Henry volume vs weak run D; Brown consistent touches+targets.

items.text: Loves Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, high aDOT/air yards; LV allows high ypr to WRs). Christian Watson vs ATL (WR8 util, 38% RZ tgts). Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% tgt share w/ Collins out; IND soft vs TEs).
items.implication: Startable with upside; Schultz boosted by Collins OUT.
items.opportunity: Olave air yards; Watson RZ; Schultz routes/tgts.

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX stout vs RBs). Travis Etienne vs LV (only 49% touches/38% 3rd down snaps). Terry McLaurin vs SEA (fewest WR pts allowed; low WAS total).
items.implication: Sit/bench candidates; Henderson narrowed gap but Stevenson still ranked ahead.
items.opportunity: Stevenson reduced post-fumble (Henderson 65% snaps after); Etienne limited role.
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson > Henderson despite usage shift.
